name: Desk & Laptop
desc: A desk, a chair and a laptop with a sticky trackpad.

name: Desk & PC
desc: Real monitor, real keyboard. Output +25%.

name: Standing Desk
desc: Output +20% and far less stress. Nobody actually stands.

name: Dual-Screen Rig
desc: Two screens, twice the tabs. Output +50%.

name: Server Rack
desc: Company-wide output +3% each (up to 5 racks). Loud. Warm.

name: Coffee Machine
desc: Restores energy. The beating heart of every office.

name: Fridge
desc: Restores hunger. Label your yogurt.

name: Toilet
desc: Restores bladder. Wall it off, for dignity.

name: Water Cooler
desc: Restores social. Better when someone else is there.

name: Sofa
desc: Restores fun and melts stress.

name: Treadmill
desc: Burns stress fast. Costs a little energy.

name: Arcade Cabinet
desc: Lots of fun. Also great for the careers page.

name: Ball Pit
desc: Prestige, fun and a strong startup smell.

name: Office Slide
desc: Pure prestige. Applicants love it.

name: Meeting Table
desc: Needed for meetings. Up to 8 people stand around it.

name: Whiteboard
desc: +1 persuasion action in meetings on this floor.

name: Projector
desc: +1 persuasion action in meetings on this floor. Slides are persuasive.

name: Plant
desc: Mood bonus for desks nearby.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
desc: Big plant, bigger mood bonus nearby.

name: Floor Lamp
desc: Warm light after dark. Mood bonus nearby.

name: Rug
desc: Walkable. Really ties the room together.

name: Aquarium
desc: Calm fish. Large mood bonus nearby.

name: Trophy Case
desc: +0.2 Rep per day. Mostly participation trophies.

name: CEO Desk
desc: Mahogany. +0.6 Rep per day. Nobody has ever worked at it.
